TagEvidence.description: One source's statement behind a tag.

detail.description: The upstream field and value as the source stated it, e.g. "openrouter architecture.output_modalities=['decisions']" or "ALCF gateway /models framework='sam3service'".
detail.title: Detail

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 time the evidence was produced (empty when the source gives none).
observed_at.title: Observed At

TagEvidence.title: TagEvidence

description: One request setting the model accepts, how to enter it, and who says so.

default.description: The value that applies when nothing is set, when a source states one; null means the provider's own default.
default.title: Default

description.description: One sentence on what the setting changes.
description.title: Description

evidence.description: Every source that states this value; the first is the winning one.
evidence.title: Evidence

maximum.description: Largest accepted value; null when unbounded.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: Smallest accepted value; null when unbounded.
minimum.title: Minimum

name.description: The setting's key as the server stores it (e.g. `temperature`, `max_tokens`, `context_length`).
name.title: Name

options.description: The accepted values of an enum; empty otherwise.
options.title: Options

step.description: A sensible increment for the control; null for an enum.
step.title: Step

title: AcceptedParameter
